name: run

test_list.description: Auto mode returns the filtered view, reconciles the ledger and exits by the ledger.
Filter mode never creates or edits the ledger.
Json mode returns the structured report and does not touch the ledger.
Issues mode reconciles and returns an empty filtered view plus the summary.
The raw bytes are in the CAS under the returned Cid.
A stream with only warnings, or an empty stream, closes issues and exits 0.
The summary text has the open count, file:line of current errors and the honesty note.
A stream over MAX_STREAM_BYTES is RtkError::StreamTooLarge before anything is stored.
A real failing cargo build in a fixture crate opens an issue (exit 1); after the fix a rerun closes it (exit 0).

output_description: Filtered view, ledger summary, raw Cid and exit code.
